trustedKeys.add.help: Paste an Ed25519 public key as PEM or base64 SPKI.
trustedKeys.add.label: Add a public key
trustedKeys.empty: You haven't trusted any keys yet.
trustedKeys.error.notBase64: That doesn't look like a PEM or base64 key — check that you copied the whole block.
trustedKeys.error.notEd25519: Not an Ed25519 public key. Only Ed25519 keys (44-byte SPKI) are accepted.
trustedKeys.intro: Plugins install only when signed by a key listed here. Compare the fingerprint with the one the publisher lists before trusting a key.
trustedKeys.remove.confirm: Stop trusting key {fingerprint}…? Plugins signed only with it will no longer install.
trustedKeys.remove.title: Remove key
